assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
as documented in the clinical indication note
To evaluate for potential arrhythmic etiologies contributing to these intermittent symptoms, a long-term continuous ECG monitoring study is ordered
a long-term continuous ECG monitoring study (CPT 93247) is ordered
This service is medically necessary to assess the cause of the patient's syncope and transient neurological deficits
The claim is denied under Reason Code CO-29
indicating that the time limit for filing has expired
the appeal requests an exception to the filing deadline based on the documented medical necessity of the service
